name: Glep
long_description:
Glep is America's AI-native financial operating system built for real estate businesses.
Our AI-native platform combines virtual and physical cards, banking, bill pay, expense management, and accounting automation into a single operating system designed specifically for how real estate businesses operate.

Glep puts more time in the hands of operators to grow their portfolio.
one_liner: AI-Native Spend platform built for Real Estate businesses
